'''Jinjur Tomas''' was a [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]] recruiter who worked in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. She discovered the location of [[Alabard's Comets]]' secret base, shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], but accepted certain payments in exchange for her secrecy. She patrolled the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] in her [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Shindra Lily]]''.<ref name="LOTE" />
